request: Windows 标签栏紧凑化、改善低素质显示器可读性，并补齐应用图标
acceptance: Windows tab strip uses compact approximately 32 DIP metrics with readable selected/inactive/hover/focus states.
Metrics and fonts update on monitor DPI changes; small windows and overflow keep controls usable.
Checked-in existing Aide branding is embedded as a multi-size EXE resource and shown by the window/taskbar.
Actual Windows screenshots reviewed at normal/narrow sizes, light/dark, and DPI-change scenarios; existing desktop/security and stop recovery checks remain green.
scope: native Windows desktop chrome and resources
isolated Windows visual/interaction tests and documentation

requirements.summary: User feedback tracked in #757; current 48 px strip / 44 px items and missing icon resources confirmed.

design.summary: 32 DIP strip, 9pt system-smoothed Segoe UI, readable solid states, adaptive widths, native overflow; embedded multi-size branding + PerMonitorV2/common-controls manifest.

implementation.summary: Native chrome/DPI/icons and resource linking implemented. Uses existing Aide mark; normal builds require no icon-generation dependency.

verification.summary: Initial AMD64 production + separate desktop fixture cross-build passed. Portable desktop policy/SDK/icon tests (3) passed. Final Windows CI/screenshot review pending.

release_authorization: Prior user authorization: integrate/push main without Release. No Mac service replacement.
handoff: LAN access from 6058f703 is an ancestor of this branch and main; included in integration. No Mac runtime replacement or Release.
